# Telex Business Support Services Inc. (TelexPH, also searched as Telex Philippines)

> Managed offshore customer support teams that work alongside AI. TelexPH runs trained Philippine support teams, with team leads, QA and monthly reporting included, for growing businesses in the US, Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada. AI handles the routine tickets; our agents handle complaints, refunds, escalations and the customers who need a real person. Founded in 2018. Based in Guimba, Nueva Ecija, Philippines.

## About TelexPH

TelexPH (Telex Business Support Services Inc.) is a Philippine business process outsourcing (BPO) company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Guimba, Nueva Ecija, about an hour from Clark. It runs managed customer support and back-office teams from 2 delivery centers in the Philippines and employs 300+ people.

TelexPH is a managed operations partner, not a staffing agency. Clients set the work priorities; TelexPH handles recruiting, SOP documentation, onboarding, daily supervision by team leads, QA reviews, KPI reporting and HR, payroll and compliance. Teams go live within 5 days of assessment completion.

US-facing brand: TELEX Global Solutions (https://intl.telexph.com), managed customer support teams built to work alongside AI.

### Key Entity Data

- Legal Name: Telex Business Support Services Inc.

- Industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Managed Customer Support, Back-Office Services
- Slogan: Scale Smarter. Support Better.

### AI + Human Model

- AI resolves routine, repetitive tickets and tasks.
- Trained TelexPH agents handle complaints, refunds, escalations, exceptions and customers who need a real person.
- AI and Automation Setup add-on: we set up AI agents, AI QA on every conversation, workflow automation and reporting for the client's team.
- Every team includes a team lead, QA and monthly reporting.

### Results From Our Teams (client names withheld)

- Global online home and garden retailer: ranked #1 of 6 support sites on customer satisfaction (Apr–Jun 2026).
- US ergonomic furniture brand, 5 agents: 95.80% quality score; 96.54% SLA (Sept 2026).
- D2C baby and kids gear brand, 4 agents: 98.86% quality score (Sept 2026); 100% attendance (Apr 2026).
- US services contractor, 3 agents + team lead: 98.47% SLA; QA 90.83%, its highest this year (Oct 2026).

### Security and Compliance

GDPR-aligned processes, a certified Data Protection Officer (DPO), Fortinet firewall protection, role-based access controls, NDAs for all employees, a CCTV-monitored workplace and a clean desk policy.

## Services

### Managed Customer Support Teams
Email, chat, phone and social support teams with team leads, QA and monthly reporting. Coverage can follow the client's time zone, including early-morning shifts that cover a full Australian business day; TelexPH operates 24/7.

### AI and Automation Setup
AI agents, AI QA on every conversation, workflow automation and reporting, set up alongside the human team.

### Back-Office Services
Order and refund processing, data entry, document processing, marketplace and catalog work, and other repeatable operations.

### Virtual Assistance
Dedicated virtual assistants for inbox and calendar, customer replies, CRM updates, sales support and admin.

### Sales Support and Lead Generation
CRM management, lead qualification, appointment setting and follow-up.

### GoHighLevel Support
GoHighLevel administration, workflows, pipelines and white-label support for agencies.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who is TelexPH for?
Growing businesses and brands in the US, Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada that need a reliable, managed offshore support or back-office team instead of hiring and managing staff themselves.

### Is TelexPH a staffing agency?
No. A staffing agency places a person and leaves. TelexPH stays involved for the whole engagement: supervision, QA, reporting, HR and replacements are part of the service.

### How does TelexPH use AI?
AI handles routine tickets and tasks; TelexPH agents handle the conversations that need judgment. Through the AI and Automation Setup add-on, TelexPH sets up AI agents, AI QA on every conversation, workflow automation and reporting.

### How fast can a team start?
Within 5 days of assessment completion.

### What if a team member doesn't perform?
If a team member falls short of agreed performance standards, TelexPH replaces them within 7 business days at no additional cost. No request needed.

### Does TelexPH offer 24/7 support?
Yes. TelexPH operates 24/7, and rosters can be matched to the client's peak hours.

### How long has TelexPH been operating?
Since 2018.

### Can I visit the office?
Yes. Site visits in Guimba, Nueva Ecija are by appointment, Monday to Friday.

### How do I get started?
Book a call at https://www.telexph.com/contact or email business@telexph.com.
